title: Humility and Happiness
reading:
The poor in spirit inherit the kingdom. Joy belongs to the humble because they are free from the burden of self.

Humility produces deep, unshakeable joy.
reflection: Is my happiness dependent on recognition? Do I rejoice in others' success? What would freedom from self-focus feel like?
abide: Blessed are the poor in spirit. The kingdom — not someday, but now — belongs to those who come empty. Come empty.
